CustomField.description: TIL requirement to calculate an estimated monthly payment. Will be used on merge docs
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Payment_Frequency__c, 'Daily'), Funding_Repayment_Amount__c / (ROUND(((Number_of_Payments__c / 5) * 7),0) / 30.4), IF( ISPICKVAL(Payment_Frequency__c, 'Weekly'), Funding_Repayment_Amount__c / (ROUND((Number_of_Payments__c * 7),0) / 30.4), null ) )
CustomField.label: Estimated Monthly Payment
